typography.usage_rules: Use IBM Plex Sans for general UI, buttons, and headings. Use IBM Plex Mono exclusively for ALL data (hashes, timestamps, numbers, table cells, identifiers). E.g., `font-mono tracking-tight`.
typography.hierarchy: H1 max `text-5xl` tracking-tighter font-medium. Body `text-base` text-[#E8E6E1]/80. Monospace hashes `text-sm` or `text-xs`. Do NOT center headings.

colors.usage_rules: Dark slate theme. NO pure white (#FFFFFF) for text, use the warm off-white (#E8E6E1). NO default Tailwind colors (blue, purple, etc.). NO purple-blue gradient meshes. Colors are for status and focus only.

visual_enhancers.seal_system: Verification stamps are the core visual signature. MUST implement as bespoke CSS/SVG components `SealStamp`. APPROVED: emerald stamp (#2FBF71), slightly rotated (e.g. -rotate-6 or rotate-3), textured ring + checkmark. REJECTED: red stamp (#F43F5E), broken/crossed out. PENDING: ghost amber stamp (#F59E0B).
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle fine-grid or noise texture on dark surfaces. Use a transparent repeating SVG background (like a 4px dot grid at 5% opacity) or CSS noise.
visual_enhancers.interactions: Micro-interactions: stamp preview on button hover. Custom focus rings (using #2FBF71), selection colors, and bespoke scrollbars (dark, thin, no gutter).
visual_enhancers.forbidden: Gradient hero pills, 'Trusted by' badge walls, emoji decoration.

grids_and_layouts.style: Editorial, asymmetric, and data-forward. Tables must have hairline rules (1px solid border_hairline), right-aligned numbers, grouped monospace hashes (e.g. `3f7a····9c2b`).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use `p-6`, `p-8`, `p-12`. Break the standard 12-column symmetry. Example: split screens (col-span-5 and col-span-7).
grids_and_layouts.panels: Panels use #151B23 with hairline borders. Minimal border-radius (e.g., `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`). Do NOT use generic Shadcn cards with heavy shadows and rounded-xl.
grids_and_layouts.forbidden: Uniform rounded-2xl icon+title+text card grids. Symmetric generic layouts. Default Vercel/Stripe look.

icons.style: Use sharp, distinct, institutional icons (e.g., weight="regular" or "duotone").

component_instructions.landing: Big statement hero + 3-step timeline (Ajukan → Review → Terverifikasi) + CTA 'Masuk'. Asymmetric split screen or editorial grid. No typical SaaS hero.
component_instructions.login: Tabs (Pemohon / Penerbit). Email step followed by a 6-digit OTP step (styled as distinct large mono inputs). Include an Admin login link.
component_instructions.owner_submit: FileDropzone for PDF (dashed hairline border, distinctive hover state). InstitutionSelect dropdown. scanReport chips. docHash displayed in large monospace.
component_instructions.owner_list: Data-forward table. StatusBadge must utilize the Seal System (mini stamps).
component_instructions.authority_workbench: Split screen layout. LEFT: pdf.js preview. RIGHT: metadata + DecisionPanel with huge, decisive Approve/Reject buttons that preview the stamp on hover.
component_instructions.admin_audit: Pending authorities table + WORM audit chain viewer with tamper indicators. Heavy use of monospace hashes and timestamp data.

motion.rules: Smooth, deliberate transitions. `duration-300 ease-out`. Do NOT use `transition-all`. Animate specific properties (opacity, transform, colors).
motion.hover_states: Buttons and list items must have distinct hover states (slight bg color shift, border highlight).

instructions_to_main_agent: Update `tailwind.config.js` to strictly map to the exact palette (#0B0F14, #151B23, #E8E6E1, #2FBF71, #F43F5E, #F59E0B). Do NOT keep default colors.
Update `index.css` to import @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans and @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono. Set body font to IBM Plex Sans and background to #0B0F14.
Implement the `SealStamp` component with SVG paths and CSS transforms to look like a physical stamp (rotated, distressed ring).
Replace generic shadcn `<Card>` rounded corners with sharp/hairline borders. Override the rounded variables to `0px` or `2px`.
Format document hashes elegantly using IBM Plex Mono, e.g., `3f7a····9c2b`.
Ensure the entire UI is in Indonesian (Ajukan, Review, Terverifikasi, Masuk, Pemohon, Penerbit).
Always add `data-testid` attributes to interactive elements and inputs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that look hand-crafted.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and hairline borders, rather than heavy drop shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, deliberate focus rings). Static = dead.
Use custom scrollbars with no gutter.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui but restyle them to fit the editorial institutional look.
